role: In-process mutual exclusion so the workout recorder's export and the foreground back-fill do not export the same session to Apple Health twice.
types: HealthExportClaims: enum — static claim/release over a locked Set<UUID>

units.does: Atomically inserts the session id; returns true if it was not already claimed. Callers: WorkoutRecorder+Metrics.swift:229 (returns when false), HealthKitManager.swift:425 (counts as failed when false).
Removes the session id from the claimed set (deferred by both callers).
